changeSet.author: hrm
changeSet.comment: Contract number and kind, job level, probation outcome and the supplement allowance of the salary split.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE SEQUENCE payroll.contract_no_seq; GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE payroll.contract_no_seq TO svc_hrm;
ALTER TABLE payroll.employment_assignment ADD COLUMN supplement_allowance shared.d_money_nonneg NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN job_level payroll.job_level, ADD COLUMN contract_kind payroll.contract_kind, ADD COLUMN contract_no TEXT, ADD COLUMN probation_result payroll.probation_result, ADD CONSTRAINT uq_employment_assignment_contract_no UNIQUE (business_id, contract_no), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_employment_assignment_probation CHECK (probation_result IS NULL OR contract_kind = 'PROBATION');
